query: Keep my main checkout up to date with origin every 10 minutes.
note: The core lane: an interval-driven pull --ff-only of the primary checkout.
Named invocation of the agent this skill backs.

query: git pull says 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' — what do I do?
note: The blocked-fast-forward case this skill owns; the answer is alert, never clobber.

query: My pull failed with 'fatal: Not possible to fast-forward, aborting.'
note: The diverged-primary row of the decision table.

query: The worktrees agents cut keep starting from an old base — the hooks and scripts are stale.
note: The exact problem this lane exists to prevent: a stale primary poisons every new worktree.

query: Set up a loop that fast-forwards the local integration branch and alerts me if it can't.
note: Describes the lane end to end without naming it.

query: Is it safe to just run git pull on the primary checkout automatically?
note: This skill's answer: only --ff-only, never a bare pull, and never resolve a refusal.

query: Something left uncommitted changes in my main clone and now it won't sync.
note: A dirty primary blocking the fast-forward — alert and stop, do not stash.

query: Keep the local repo current on an interval but never touch my worktrees.
note: Scope rule: the primary checkout only, worktrees are off limits.

query: My PR is green but won't merge — why?
note: Post-open PR lifecycle, not local branch syncing.

query: Rebase my feature branch onto main and force-push it.
note: This lane never rebases or force-pushes anything; it is fast-forward only.

query: Resolve the merge conflict on my branch.
note: This skill explicitly never resolves conflicts — it alerts and stops.

query: Delete the local branches whose PRs already merged.
note: Post-merge branch/worktree cleanup is the pr-cleanup lane.

query: CI is taking 50 minutes — speed it up.
note: CI latency lane, unrelated to local checkout syncing.

query: A test passes on retry but reds the merge queue intermittently.
Create a worktree for me to work in.
note: Worktree creation is not this lane; it only reads the primary and never touches worktrees.
This lane only pulls; it never pushes.

query: Why did auto-merge get dropped on PR #412?
note: Merge-queue/auto-merge health is the pr-checks lane.
